Plotting Static Network Graphs with ggraph package ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link() + geom_node_point() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link(aes(colour = 'grey50')) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = 'grey40')) g + theme_graph(background = 'grey10', text_colour = 'white') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: #### Fruchterman and Reingold layout ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes()) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-12-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: #### Modifying network node ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size = 3)) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: #### Modifying edges ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 3) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: #### Creating facet graphs ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') ### uses theme() to change the position of the legend g + facet_edges(~Weekday) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-15-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: Additional: add frames to the faceted graphs can add the following codes ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g + facet_edges(~Weekday) + th_foreground(foreground = "grey80", border = TRUE) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') ``` ::: #### Working with facet_nodes() ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set_graph_style() g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) g + facet_nodes(~Department)+ th_foreground(foreground = "grey80", border = TRUE) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom') ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-17-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: ### Network Metrics Analysis #### Computing centrality indices ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% mutate(betweenness_centrality = centrality_betweenness()) %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size=betweenness_centrality)) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-18-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: #### Visualising network metrics ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size = centrality_betweenness())) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-19-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: #### Visualising Community ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} g <- GAStech_graph %>% activate(nodes) %>% mutate(community = as.factor( group_optimal(weights = Weight)), betweenness_measure = centrality_betweenness()) %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_mark_hull( aes(x, y, group = community, fill = community), alpha = 0.2, expand = unit(0.3, "cm"), # Expand radius = unit(0.3, "cm") # Smoothness ) + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(fill = Department, size = betweenness_measure), color = "black", shape = 21) g + theme_graph() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-20-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: ### Building Interactive Network Graph with visNetwork #### Data Preparation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_edges_aggregated <- GAStech_edges %>% left_join(GAStech_nodes, by = c("sourceLabel" = "label")) %>% rename(from = id) %>% left_join(GAStech_nodes, by = c("targetLabel" = "label")) %>% rename(to = id) %>% filter(MainSubject == "Work related") %>% group_by(from, to) %>% summarise(weight = n()) %>% filter(from!=to) %>% filter(weight > 1) %>% ungroup() ``` ::: #### Plotting the first interactive network graph ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: #### Working with visual attributes - Nodes ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} GAStech_nodes <- GAStech_nodes %>% rename(group = Department) visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: #### Working with visual attributes - Edges ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visEdges(arrows = "to", smooth = list(enabled = TRUE, type = "curvedCW")) %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: #### Interactivity ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>% visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>% visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE, nodesIdSelection = TRUE) %>% visLegend() %>% visLayout(randomSeed = 123) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## Chapeter 29: Visualising and Analysing Text Data with R: tidytext methods ### Installing packages ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pacman::p_load(tidytext, widyr, wordcloud, DT, ggwordcloud, textplot, lubridate, hms, tidyverse, tidygraph, ggraph, igraph) ``` ::: ### Importing Multiple Text Files from Multiple Folders ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} news20 <- "data/20news/" ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} read_folder <- function(infolder) { tibble(file = dir(infolder, full.names = TRUE)) %>% mutate(text = map(file, read_lines)) %>% transmute(id = basename(file), text) %>% unnest(text) } ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} raw_text <- tibble(folder = dir(news20, full.names = TRUE)) %>% mutate(folder_out = map(folder, read_folder)) %>% unnest(cols = c(folder_out)) %>% transmute(newsgroup = basename(folder), id, text) write_rds(raw_text, "data/rds/news20.rds") ``` ::: ::: code-tip - [`read_lines()`](https://readr.tidyverse.org/reference/read_lines.html) of [**readr**](https://readr.tidyverse.org/) package is used to read up to n_max lines from a file. - [`map()`](https://purrr.tidyverse.org/reference/map.html) of [**purrr**](https://purrr.tidyverse.org/) package is used to transform their input by applying a function to each element of a list and returning an object of the same length as the input. - [`unnest()`](https://tidyr.tidyverse.org/reference/nest.html) of **dplyr** package is used to flatten a list-column of data frames back out into regular columns. - [`mutate()`](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/mutate.html) of **dplyr** is used to add new variables and preserves existing ones; - [`transmute()`](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/mutate.html) of **dplyr** is used to add new variables and drops existing ones. - [`read_rds()`](https://readr.tidyverse.org/reference/read_rds.html) is used to save the extracted and combined data frame as rds file for future use. ::: ### Initial EDA ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} raw_text <- read_rds("data/rds/news20.rds") raw_text %>% group_by(newsgroup) %>% summarize(messages = n_distinct(id)) %>% ggplot(aes(messages, newsgroup)) + geom_col(fill = "lightblue") + labs(y = NULL) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-30-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: #### Removing header and automated email signitures ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cleaned_text <- raw_text %>% group_by(newsgroup, id) %>% filter(cumsum(text == "") > 0, cumsum(str_detect( text, "^--")) == 0) %>% ungroup() ``` ::: ::: code-tip - [`cumsum()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/cumsum.html) of base R is used to return a vector whose elements are the cumulative sums of the elements of the argument. - [`str_detect()`](https://stringr.tidyverse.org/reference/str_detect.html) from **stringr** is used to detect the presence or absence of a pattern in a string. ::: #### Removing lines with nested text representing quotes from other users ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cleaned_text <- cleaned_text %>% filter(str_detect(text, "^[^>]+[A-Za-z\\d]") | text == "", !str_detect(text, "writes(:|\\.\\.\\.)$"), !str_detect(text, "^In article <") ) ``` ::: ::: code-tip - [`str_detect()`](https://stringr.tidyverse.org/reference/str_detect.html) from **stringr** is used to detect the presence or absence of a pattern in a string. - [`filter()`](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/filter.html) of **dplyr** package is used to subset a data frame, retaining all rows that satisfy the specified conditions. ::: #### Text data processing ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) library(tidytext) usenet_words <- cleaned_text %>% unnest_tokens(word, text) %>% filter(str_detect(word, "[a-z']$"), !word %in% stop_words$word) usenet_words %>% count(word, sort = TRUE) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 5,542 × 2 word n 1 people 57 2 time 50 3 jesus 47 4 god 44 5 message 40 6 br 27 7 bible 23 8 drive 23 9 homosexual 23 10 read 22 # ℹ 5,532 more rows ``` ::: ::: Use below codes to count words within by newsgroup ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} words_by_newsgroup <- usenet_words %>% count(newsgroup, word, sort = TRUE) %>% ungroup() ``` ::: #### Visualising Words in newsgroups ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} wordcloud(words_by_newsgroup$word, words_by_newsgroup$n, max.words = 300) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-35-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(1234) words_by_newsgroup %>% filter(n > 0) %>% ggplot(aes(label = word, size = n)) + geom_text_wordcloud() + theme_minimal() + facet_wrap(~newsgroup) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-36-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: #### Computing tf-idf within newsgroups ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tf_idf <- words_by_newsgroup %>% bind_tf_idf(word, newsgroup, n) %>% arrange(desc(tf_idf)) ``` ::: #### Visualising tf-idf within newsgroups ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tf_idf %>% filter(str_detect(newsgroup, "^sci\\.")) %>% group_by(newsgroup) %>% slice_max(tf_idf, n = 12) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(word = reorder(word, tf_idf)) %>% ggplot(aes(tf_idf, word, fill = newsgroup)) + geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) + facet_wrap(~ newsgroup, scales = "free") + labs(x = "tf-idf", y = NULL) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-38-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: #### Counting and correlating pairs of words with the widyr package ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} newsgroup_cors <- words_by_newsgroup %>% pairwise_cor(newsgroup, word, n, sort = TRUE) ``` ::: #### Visualising correlation as a network ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(2017) newsgroup_cors %>% filter(correlation > .025) %>% graph_from_data_frame() %>% ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes(alpha = correlation, width = correlation)) + geom_node_point(size = 6, color = "lightblue") + geom_node_text(aes(label = name), color = "red", repel = TRUE) + theme_void() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-40-1.png){width=1152} ::: ::: #### Bigram ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} bigrams <- cleaned_text %>% unnest_tokens(bigram, text, token = "ngrams", n = 2) ### counting bigrams bigrams_count <- bigrams %>% filter(bigram != 'NA') %>% count(bigram, sort = TRUE) ### cleaning bigrams bigrams_separated <- bigrams %>% filter(bigram != 'NA') %>% separate(bigram, c("word1", "word2"), sep = " ") bigrams_filtered <- bigrams_separated %>% filter(!word1 %in% stop_words$word) %>% filter(!word2 %in% stop_words$word) ### counting again bigram_counts <- bigrams_filtered %>% count(word1, word2, sort = TRUE) ``` ::: #### Create a network graph from bigram data frame ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} bigram_graph <- bigram_counts %>% filter(n > 3) %>% graph_from_data_frame() bigram_graph ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` IGRAPH d187277 DN-- 40 24 -- + attr: name (v/c), n (e/n) + edges from d187277 (vertex names): [1] 1 ->2 1 ->3 static ->void [4] time ->pad 1 ->4 infield ->fly [7] mat ->28 vv ->vv 1 ->5 [10] cock ->crow noticeshell->widget 27 ->1993 [13] 3 ->4 child ->molestation cock ->crew [16] gun ->violence heat ->sink homosexual ->male [19] homosexual ->women include ->xol mary ->magdalene [22] read ->write rev ->20 tt ->ee ``` ::: ::: #### Visualizing a network of bigrams with ggraph ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(1234) a <- grid::arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(.15, "inches")) ggraph(bigram_graph, layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes(edge_alpha = n), show.legend = FALSE, arrow = a, end_cap = circle(.07, 'inches')) + geom_node_point(color = "lightblue", size = 5) + geom_node_text(aes(label = name), vjust = 1, hjust = 1) + theme_void() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Hands-on_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-43-1.png){width=1152} ::: :::
